lines.text: Everyone sees the Lambo. The parties. The lifestyle.
Nobody sees the bill. Two hundred fifty grand is just the sticker.
Sales tax? Seventeen and a half grand. Day one.
Depreciation burns another seventeen thousand. Every year.
Insurance, sixty-six hundred. Service, two grand. Tires, three thousand.
And that quarter million, invested, would've made you twelve and a half grand.
Fifty-eight thousand seven hundred dollars. Year one. Just to be seen in it.
They see the flex. Now you know the math. Still want the Lambo?
